dais.reason: The plinth is what the sanctuary is for. A body may climb it and nothing is ever asked to walk over it.

frieze.reason: The set-back courses of the west and south walls are dressing on an outward face. A body can be lifted into them and nothing is ever asked to walk there.

contract.no_body_majority_ack: Most of this hall is floor a body walks; the set-back courses and the plinth are the only cells that are not, and they are dressing.
